article.title: Azure API Management vulnerability exploited to steal customers’ secrets
article.summary: Attackers have exploited a vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) to steal credentials stored in customers’ instances, Microsoft has warned. Among the victims are several Norwegian organizations, including energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi, and organizations in other sectors and outside Norway, the country’s National Security Authority (NSM) confirmed. APIM Classic tiers affected APIM is a gateway that sits in front of an organization’s APIs and handles authentication, routing and rate limiting. article.title: CISA warns of exploited N-able bug as company restores email platform
article.summary: The U.S. cyber agency is giving government departments until Thanksgiving to patch a vulnerability impacting a critical email security platform that blocks spam, malware and other threats.
